thesis: AI-datacenter transceiver capacity play: 800G/1.6T ramp to hyperscalers (Amazon/Microsoft) lifts revenue 2.5x in 2027 on consensus; the trade is whether GM holds ~28-30% and whether the 2027 EPS ($4.60, 5 analysts) survives pricing pressure. Net cash after the ATM; the 2030 converts are deep ITM (dilution, not debt).

consensus.source: Seeking Alpha consensus, owner screenshot 2026-09-17 (SA EPS normalized)
consensus.thin_coverage_note: FY2028 EPS 8.91 carried by ONE analyst (owner note 2026-09-17) — excluded from the ladder under the >=3 rule; FY2028 revenue 3.96B kept as context but no rung prices it

pt_model.basis: Earnings lens (FY2027 EPS 4.60 x 30). 30x is ASSISTANT-SET, OWNER TO CONFIRM: street PT $151 inverts to 32.9x FY27; a name doubling revenue with GM <30% should not carry LITE-class 40x+. Floor 15x. Shares 84.9M out + ~2.9M from the 2030 converts (conv $43.31) = ~88M. Net cash ~$0.9B post-ATM ($508.8M 6/30 cash - $129M convert carrying + ~$539M ATM) — CONFIRM on the Q3 10-Q.

hinges.label: FY2027 consensus EPS holds >= $4.00 through the Q3 print
